name: Rebalancer arbitrary call spends its owner's Aave credit delegation
summary: The unverified rebalancer 0x7a7bab45, to which its deployer had delegated unlimited WAVAX borrowing on Aave V3, exposes a function (0xb2a13230) that borrows for the caller and then executes caller-supplied target and calldata from the rebalancer's own address. The attacker had it call Pool.borrow(WAVAX, 7000e18, variable, 0, deployer) against the delegation and then WAVAX.transfer to the attack contract.
notes: The reset is the deployer's approveDelegation(rebalancer, max) on variableDebtAvaWAVAX, a borrowing grant the exploit spent, made 17,420 blocks after the rebalancer's deployment. The allowance stayed at max until the anchor, so the delegation was never spent before; the deployer revoked it about 38,000 blocks later (0xdeddb5de).
Not a rescue: the attacker EOA forwarded the 6,999.91 WAVAX to 0x36b11287 (0xfabb46bc), the address that funded it and collects its other proceeds; nothing went back to the victim.
Loss is the 7,000 WAVAX borrowed against the victim's delegation; the victim's debt-token balance rose by 7,047 because it includes interest accrued on its existing debt.
